name: Itadaki Djungarian R
original_name: いただきじゃんがりあんR
source:
One year since then...
Now, a new battle was about to begin...

"It’s a disaster, a total disaster, big brother!"

As if shattering the brief period of peaceful daily life, Suzune's voice rings out through Jangarian. To Kazumi, who asks what's wrong, Suzune points toward the window she just opened.

"W-What did you say!?"

When they look out the window—right in front of Jangarian—where there should have been a liquor store and a diner until yesterday, for some reason, there stands an Annie’s.
Suzune wonders why there's an Annie’s here when there’s already one in front of the station...
Kazumi thinks he’s lucky to have an Annie’s so close by.

"Geez, if a competitor opens up this close, our shop is really going to go under this time, Big Brother!"

He had to admit she had a point.
Besides, Kazumi figured there was no reason to go out of the way to build another branch in this spot, which was already within a 10-minute walk of the station.

"What should we do, big brother?"

"In that case, we’re going to march right in there, Suzune!"

"Eeeeeeehhhhh!?"

What awaits the two of them as they storm directly into Annie’s...!?
